verdict.rationale: Freshsales' own marketing page says it can 'capture, qualify, route, and track' leads with Freddy AI, which is a first-party claim of automatic lead routing. That claim is a single thin mention with no detail on how routing works. Missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, round-robin distribution, owner-matching criteria, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin

citations.quote: capture, qualify, route, and track them with the power of Freddy AI.
